name: darkest_dungeon_patches
description: Native Linux and Windows engine patches for Darkest Dungeon

scripts.format: uv run --locked ruff check --fix . && uv run --locked ruff format . && clang-format -i src/native/common/*.[ch] src/native/linux/*.[ch] src/native/windows/*.[ch]
scripts.check:python: uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check .
scripts.check:tidy: clang-tidy src/native/common/*.c src/native/linux/*.c --warnings-as-errors='*' -- -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror && clang-tidy src/native/common/*.c src/native/linux/*.c --warnings-as-errors='*' -- -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -DDD_PATCH_SELFTEST
scripts.check: pnpm run check:python && pnpm run check:format && pnpm run check:tidy
